prior_findings.finding: Pending child nonzero/error and operator-stop controls absent from the initial GREEN snapshot
prior_findings.evidence: The committed integration test adds pending-failed-child, pending-child-error, and completion-stop scenarios. The admitted controls run reports 3/3 passing, and its outer journal ends valid after child exit 0. Each inner scenario asserts exit 3 and invalid final decision; child error and stop also assert their causal events.

verdict_A_behavior_acceptance.evidence: The committed guard records child exit 0 during CPU pending, retains the same lease, disables further native actions through RESOURCE_JOB_EXIT, and continues the existing watch. Controlled scenarios assert confirmed recovery returns valid, while second bad CPU, confirmation expiry, memory unsafe, child failure/error, and operator stop return invalid. No exact-artifact, resource-valid Settings native run was reviewed.
verdict_A_behavior_acceptance.remaining: Run one admitted native Settings retest on the exact artifact before closing D168 or crediting acceptance. ARM 37732615934 remains invalid.

verdict_B_code_quality_evidence.evidence: The change reuses the existing CPU episode, watch, lease, and native-action boundary. The old-behavior mutant fails causally; committed GREEN and controls GREEN runs pass under the real outer host guard. Recorded SHA-256 values match all six committed log and journal files. The policy only adds an explanation; its stop count, healthy count, and timeout calculation are unchanged.
verdict_B_code_quality_evidence.limits: Inner scratch guards stub telemetry and legacy-host ownership, so these are controlled lifecycle checks, not a real CPU spike or native Settings proof. Measurement failure after successful child exit has no dedicated completion scenario; production cpuEpisode classifies non-CPU measurement failure as terminal unsafe, and the guard's existing unsafe branch invalidates the run. This is an evidence limit, not an observed breakage.

review_method: Inspected exact builder commits, defect and prior peer report, production guard and CPU episode, native-action boundary, integration assertions, six evidence file hashes, and real outer control journal. No source, native job, build, launch, child agent, or redundant test run by reviewer.
